name: "Natsuriba!" ~Natsu & Tomodachi & Liberty Days~
original_name: 『ナツリバ！』～ナツ＆トモダチ＆リバティデイズ～
source:
Our protagonist (Shinyama Takuto) is an ordinary gay student who lives alone as he attends school.  School life is completely normal, but even then our protagonist going through puberty is caught between the love of his friend and his teacher.  This one summer will pass and never return.  Who should he spend the summer with?

Character route and uke/seme story will change based off affection level and choices.
translation:
主人公新山拓人是一名普通的同性恋学生，独自生活并上学。校园生活本来十分平常，但正值青春期的他，陷入了朋友与老师的爱恋之间。这个夏天终将过去，再也不会回来。他应该和谁一起度过夏天？

角色路线以及攻受故事会根据好感度和选择发生变化。
